verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show that LaunchDarkly's core flag-management platform can be self-hosted. The only on-premises component is the Relay Proxy, a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure but still connects to LaunchDarkly's streaming API, so it depends on the hosted service. That is an adjacent component, not a self-hosted core product, and it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure. It connects to the LaunchDarkly streaming API and proxies that connection to clients
